This page is generated from the WASM parser module's `describe` output by

datamitsu ships a single signed Rust → WASM module (`datamitsu-parsers`, version `0.1.0`) that turns these **92 tools**' raw output into structured diagnostics. Wire one to a tool with [`outputParser`](./configuration-api.md#output-parser-outputparser) — the **Parser** name below is its `parser` field.
